rule_hit_review.why: Headline names Vitamin B12 with no concentration in that field; advisory only, since the product name carries 03%.
Primary text names Vitamin B12 with no concentration in that field; advisory only.

tone_read: Calm, educational and ingredient-led: it names the actives, what they do and how to use the product, with no fear, hype or urgency. It reads like Minimalist.
language_read: Efficacy is hedged ("help prevent water loss") and every claim traces to the product page. The 03% strength is written as the brand writes it, but the hero active is named without its percentage in the headline and primary text.
